**Finding submitted: missing (insurance).**

- **What I checked:** A document-wide search for "insurance" returned only p0051, where insurance is listed among taxes/duties/charges payable by Licensee — no coverage obligation on Licensor. The section outline shows no insurance heading, and I read all of General Provisions (p0144–p0160) to confirm nothing appears there.
- **Why it fails:** Licensor hosts the Platform and handles our data, so the rule expects coverage. Zero insurance is below the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) and near walk-away for a vendor processing our data.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New General Provisions (l) INSURANCE inserted after p0159, at the preferred position — CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M while Licensor handles our data, workers' comp as required by law, certificates on request, term plus one year. The comment flags the fallback limits as a negotiable landing zone.
